user_request: /adk-system-designer I want to build an ADK agent that summarises our sales calls from Gong transcripts and updates the opportunity in Salesforce. Help me design it.
assertions: Asks about the deadline and whether the work continues afterwards.
Asks how many people build it, their hours and their ADK/GCP familiarity.
Asks about the data touched and what the agent may change, and explains why that sets the risk.
Offers defaults the user can accept in one word and stops to wait instead of writing a full design.
Keeps the first reply short enough for a busy user to answer.
